Container.Name: the-curator

Branch.TagDescription: Latest stable build from main branch

Container.Overview: Plex Library Manager — browse your library publicly and manage disk space from an admin dashboard. Connects to Plex and Tautulli to surface pruning signals.
Container.Requires: Plex Media Server and Tautulli running on the same server.

Config.Name: Database Path
Config.Description: Path to SQLite database inside the container.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: URL of your Plex server. Use 172.17.0.1 for host access from bridge network, or the container name if using a custom network.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Your Plex authentication token. Find it in Plex Web: open any item → Get Info → View XML → look for X-Plex-Token in the URL.

Config.Name: Tautulli API Key
Config.Description: Your Tautulli API key. Find it in Tautulli: Settings → Web Interface → API Key.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Password for the admin dashboard at /login.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Random string for signing session cookies. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
